sources.title: flux-2-klein-4b - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: FLUX.2 [klein] is an ultra-fast, distilled image model. It unifies image generation and editing in a single model, delivering state-of-the-art quality enabling interactive workflows, real-time previews, and latency-critical applications.

sources.title: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B is Black Forest Labs' flagship small model, designed to sit on the quality-latency Pareto frontier for text-to-image, single-reference editing, and multi-reference generation. It is described as a 9B flow model using an 8B Qwen3 text embedder and distilled to run in 4 inference steps for sub-second workflows.
